data.gender_notes: Ibhaa is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ibhaa is a Sanskrit name derived from the root 'ibh' meaning 'radiance' or 'shining light'. In Hindu mythology, Ibhaa is the name of a goddess representing the radiance of the sun and the inner light of consciousness. The name Ibhaa carries the meaning “Radiance, Shining Light” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ibhaa usually hope their child will grow to embody radiance, shining light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of inner radiance and self-illumination.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ibhaa total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
